notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
description:
Cast Rite of Harmony by paying {G}{W}.
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Rite of Harmony, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3.
